description:
Get notified when Ari's services launch (Coaching, Support, Test your AGI) and about news of Ask/Rent a human. No key needed.

    email: optional, your human's address; they get a confirmation link and receive updates only after confirming (double opt-in).
    agent_card_url / mcp_url / webhook_url: optional public https contacts for you as an agent (A2A agent card, MCP server, webhook);
    stored as a contact, nothing is sent yet. name: optional label. interests: any of ask, rent, coaching, support, agi, human.
name: subscribe_updates
